As a reach truck driver, you will ensure a smooth logistics process within the warehouse. Your duties include: - Loading and unloading goods; - Checking incoming and outgoing products; - Transporting and order picking of goods with a Reach truck; - Ensuring a neat and organized work environment; - And adherence to hygiene rules. 
 The offer 
You can count on excellent working conditions: - A gross hourly wage of €15.96; - 3.4% production surcharge; - A cold surcharge of €2.16 per day; - 15% shift allowance; - A 38-hour work week; - And special work clothes to work comfortably in a refrigerated environment. 
 Job requirements 
For this position, you possess: - A valid reach truck certificate and experience in logistics; - Command of the Dutch or English language; - No objection to working in 0-degree environments; - Flexibility and willingness to work occasional weekends; - And affinity for meat (products) is a plus. 
 The company 
You will be working at Van Loon Group in Best. An ambitious family business with over 50 years of experience in the production of high quality meat and convenience products. The organization combines craftsmanship with innovation and sustainability and supplies its products through various channels to retail, foodservice and industry.
